d: Adjunct Faculty Opportunities – Faculty of Language Studies

The Arab Open University – Oman invites qualified and experienced candidates to apply for Adjunct Faculty teaching opportunities within the Faculty of Language Studies (FLS) for the Spring Semester of the Academic Year 2026–2027.
q: Hold both a Bachelor's and Master's degree in one of the following fields:
Applicants holding a PhD in a relevant discipline are also encouraged to apply.

Applicants holding a Master's degree in English Language Teaching (ELT), TESOL, Curriculum and Teaching Methods in English, or a closely related field may also apply. However, preference will be given to candidates who meet the qualifications specified under Point 1 above.
Professional qualifications such as TESOL, TEFL, CELTA, DELTA , or other recognized English Language Teaching certifications will be considered an added advantage.
Demonstrated teaching experience at the university or higher education level .
A record of research publications in relevant academic fields .
An IELTS Academic overall band score of 7.0 or above , or an equivalent recognized English language proficiency qualification.
Successful applicants are expected to demonstrate
Excellent command of spoken and written English.
Ability to teach undergraduate courses in language, linguistics, literature, and English language skills.
Strong communication, teamwork, and interpersonal skills.
Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and blended/online teaching environments.
Ability to work effectively in a multicultural academic environment.
Commitment to academic quality assurance and student-centered teaching practices.
Morning teaching availability is a key requirement to meet the Faculty's scheduling needs. Applicants should be:
Available to teach morning classes on weekdays.
Available to teach morning classes on weekends.
Preference will be given to candidates who are available for morning teaching assignments.
Applicants will be required to specify their morning teaching availability as part of the application process.
x: Interested candidates are invited to submit their application along with
Details of teaching and research experience.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further assessment.
The deadline for receiving applications is 30 Nov 2026 Via the University's website
